G1500.def:
εἰκῇ (-ῆ, Rec., as in cl.), adv.,
[in LXX: Pv 28:25 (εἰκῇ)* ;]
__1. without cause or reason: Mt 5:22 (E, mg.), Cl 2:18 (ICC).
__2. vainly, fruitlessly, to no purpose: Rm 13:4, 1Co 15:2, Gl 3:4 4:11, Cl 2:18.
† (AS)

G1501.def:
εἴκοσι (never -ιν in WH, cf. Bl., §5, 3, and note), indecl., οἱ, αἱ, τά,
twenty: Lc 14:31, Jo 6:19, At 1:15 27:28, 1Co 10:8, Ap 4:4, 10 5:8 11:16 19:4.†
(AS)

G1503.def:
εἴκω (obsolete pres.), see: ἔοικα Transcriber note: This form does not occur in Abbott-Smith. It should be on p. 158..
(AS)

G1504.def:
εἰκών, -όνος (cf. ἔοικα),
[in LXX chiefly for צֶלֶם ;]
an image, likeness: Mt 22:20, Mc 12:16, Lc 20:24, Rm 1:23, 1Co 15:49, Ap 13:14, 15 14:9, 11 15:2 16:2 19:20 20:4; opposite to σκιά, Hb 10:1; of man, εἰ. θεοῦ, 1 Co 11:7; of the regenerate, εἰ. τ. θεοῦ Cl 3:10 (see Lft., in l.); εἰ. τ. υἱοῦ τ. θεοῦ, Rm 8:29, 2Co 3:18; of Christ, εἰ. τ. θεοῦ, 2Co 4:4, Cl 1:15.† SYN.: ὁμοίωμα, denoting resemblance, which may however be merely accidental. εἰ. is a derived likeness and like the head on a coin or the parental likeness in a child, implies an archetype. Cf. also εἶδος, appearance, not necessarily based on reality; σκιά, a shadowed resemblance; χαρακτήρ, the impress of a stamp; μόρφη (which see), the form as indicative of the inner being.
(AS)

G1505.def:
εἰλικρινία (Rec., cl., -κρινεία), -ας, ἡ
(εἰλικρινής), [in LXX: Wis.7:25 A * ;]
sincerity, purity: 1Co 5:8, 2Co 1:12 2:17.†
(AS)

G1506.def:
εἰλικρινής, -ές,
[in LXX: Wi 72^ kB * ;]
unalloyed, pure (Lat. sincerus; see DCG, ii, 635a);
__(a) of unmixed substances;
__(b) of abstract ideas;
__(with) of ethical purity: Fp 1:10, 2Pe 3:1.†
SYN.: ἁγνός (which see), καθαρός, cf. Tr., Syn.: §lxxxv; DB, iv, 176a; Cremer, 378; Westc. on 1Jo 3:3. (AS)

G1510.def:
εἰμί,
with various uses and significations, like the English verb to be.
__I. As substantive verb.
__1. Of persons and things, to be, exist: At 17:28, Jo 1:1, 8:58, 17:5, al; ὁ ὢν καὶ ὁ ἦν (for past ptcp.), Ap 1:4, 8, 4:8, 11:17, 16:5 (see Swete, Ap., 5; M, Pr., 228); τὰ (μὴ) ὄντα, Rm 4:17, 1Co 1:28.
__2. Of times, events, etc., to be, happen, take place: Mt 24:3, Mc 14:2, 15:42, Lc 21:23, Jo 4:6, 23, 5:10, al.
__3. to be present, be in a place, have come: Mt 2:13, 15, Mc 1:45, 5:21, 15:40, Lc 1:80, 5:29, Jo 7:30, al.; before εἰς, Mc 2:1; before ἐκ, (ἐξ), Mt 1:20, 21:25, Mc 11:30, Jo 3:31, al.
__4. Impers., ἔστι, ἦν, etc.;
__(a) there is (Fr. il y a), was, etc.: Mt 16:28, Lc 16:19, Jo 3:1, 5:2, Rm 3:10, al.; with dative (of the possessor; Bl., §37, 3), Mt 16:22, Lc 1:7, Jo 18:10, Rm 9:2, al.; ἔστιν ὅς, ὅστις (chiefly in pl), Mt 16:28, 19:2, Mc 9:1, al.;
__(b) with inf., = ἔξεστιν (which see), it is possible: Hb 9:5, 1Co 11:20, RV (but see ICC, in l.).
__II. As copula uniting subject and predicate.
__1. Expressing simply identity or equivalence: Mt 5:13, 14:15, Lc 1:18, 19, Jo 1:1, 4:19, Ap 3:9, al. mult.
__2. Explicative, as in parable, figure, type, etc.: Mt 13:19, 1Co 9:2, 10:4, 11:25, Gl 4:24, Ap 17:15, al.; ταῦτ᾽ ἔστιν, Mt 27:46, Mc 7:2, Rm 7:18 al.; ὅ ἐστιν, Mc 3:17, Cl 1:24, Hb 7:2, al.; akin to this is the sacramental usage: Mt 26:26-28, Mc 14:22, 24, Lc 22:19, 1Co 11:24 (see ICC on Mk, I Co, ll. with; DB, iii, 148 f.).
__3. C. genitive: qual., etc., Mc 5:42, Lc 3:23, 1Co 14:33, Hb 12:11, al.; part., 1Tm 1:20, 2Tm 1:15; poss., Mt 5:3, 10, Mc 12:7, Lc 4:7; of service or partisanship, Rm 8:9, 1Co 1:12, 2Co 10:7, 2Tm 2:19.
__4. C. dative (BL, §37, 3): At 1:8, 9:15, Rm 4:12, 1Co 1:18, 2:14, Ap 21:7, al.
__5. C. ptcp., as a periphrasis for the simple verb (Bl., §62, 1, 2; M, Pr., 225 ff.);
__(a) with ptcp. pf. (cl.): Mt 10:30, Lc 9:32, Jo 3:24, At 21:35, 1Co 15:19, al;
__(b) with ptcp. pr. (esp. in impf., as in Heb. and Aram.; Dalman, Words, 35 f.), Mt 7:29, Mc 1:22, Lc 4:31, 14:1, At 1:10, al. mult., id. for imper. (M, Pr., 180f., 182f.), with ellipsis of εἰμί, Rm 12:9, 10, Hb 13:5, al.;
__(with) with ptcp. aor. (cl), Lc 23:9.
__6. Seq. εἰς (cf. Heb. הָיָה לְ), a vernac. usage (M, Pr., 71): Mt 19:5, Mc 10:8, Hb 8:10, al.
__7. C. adv.: Mt 19:20, Mc 4:26, Lc 18:11, al.
__8. Ellipses;
__(a) of the copula (Bl., §30, 3): Mt 8:29, 24:32, Jo 21:22, 23, Hb 6:4, al.;
__(b) of the predicate: ἐγώ εἰμί, Mt 14:27, Mc 6:50, al.; absol. (cf. Dt 32:39; אֲנִי הוּא), Mc 13:6, Jo 4:26, al. (cf. ἄπ-, ἔν-, πάρ-, συμ-πάρ-, σύν-ειμι).
(AS)

G1511.def:
εἰμί,
with various uses and significations, like the English verb to be.
__I. As substantive verb.
__1. Of persons and things, to be, exist: At 17:28, Jo 1:1, 8:58, 17:5, al; ὁ ὢν καὶ ὁ ἦν (for past ptcp.), Ap 1:4, 8, 4:8, 11:17, 16:5 (see Swete, Ap., 5; M, Pr., 228); τὰ (μὴ) ὄντα, Rm 4:17, 1Co 1:28.
__2. Of times, events, etc., to be, happen, take place: Mt 24:3, Mc 14:2, 15:42, Lc 21:23, Jo 4:6, 23, 5:10, al.
__3. to be present, be in a place, have come: Mt 2:13, 15, Mc 1:45, 5:21, 15:40, Lc 1:80, 5:29, Jo 7:30, al.; before εἰς, Mc 2:1; before ἐκ, (ἐξ), Mt 1:20, 21:25, Mc 11:30, Jo 3:31, al.
__4. Impers., ἔστι, ἦν, etc.;
__(a) there is (Fr. il y a), was, etc.: Mt 16:28, Lc 16:19, Jo 3:1, 5:2, Rm 3:10, al.; with dative (of the possessor; Bl., §37, 3), Mt 16:22, Lc 1:7, Jo 18:10, Rm 9:2, al.; ἔστιν ὅς, ὅστις (chiefly in pl), Mt 16:28, 19:2, Mc 9:1, al.;
__(b) with inf., = ἔξεστιν (which see), it is possible: Hb 9:5, 1Co 11:20, RV (but see ICC, in l.).
__II. As copula uniting subject and predicate.
__1. Expressing simply identity or equivalence: Mt 5:13, 14:15, Lc 1:18, 19, Jo 1:1, 4:19, Ap 3:9, al. mult.
__2. Explicative, as in parable, figure, type, etc.: Mt 13:19, 1Co 9:2, 10:4, 11:25, Gl 4:24, Ap 17:15, al.; ταῦτ᾽ ἔστιν, Mt 27:46, Mc 7:2, Rm 7:18 al.; ὅ ἐστιν, Mc 3:17, Cl 1:24, Hb 7:2, al.; akin to this is the sacramental usage: Mt 26:26-28, Mc 14:22, 24, Lc 22:19, 1Co 11:24 (see ICC on Mk, I Co, ll. with; DB, iii, 148 f.).
__3. C. genitive: qual., etc., Mc 5:42, Lc 3:23, 1Co 14:33, Hb 12:11, al.; part., 1Tm 1:20, 2Tm 1:15; poss., Mt 5:3, 10, Mc 12:7, Lc 4:7; of service or partisanship, Rm 8:9, 1Co 1:12, 2Co 10:7, 2Tm 2:19.
__4. C. dative (BL, §37, 3): At 1:8, 9:15, Rm 4:12, 1Co 1:18, 2:14, Ap 21:7, al.
__5. C. ptcp., as a periphrasis for the simple verb (Bl., §62, 1, 2; M, Pr., 225 ff.);
__(a) with ptcp. pf. (cl.): Mt 10:30, Lc 9:32, Jo 3:24, At 21:35, 1Co 15:19, al;
__(b) with ptcp. pr. (esp. in impf., as in Heb. and Aram.; Dalman, Words, 35 f.), Mt 7:29, Mc 1:22, Lc 4:31, 14:1, At 1:10, al. mult., id. for imper. (M, Pr., 180f., 182f.), with ellipsis of εἰμί, Rm 12:9, 10, Hb 13:5, al.;
__(with) with ptcp. aor. (cl), Lc 23:9.
__6. Seq. εἰς (cf. Heb. הָיָה לְ), a vernac. usage (M, Pr., 71): Mt 19:5, Mc 10:8, Hb 8:10, al.
__7. C. adv.: Mt 19:20, Mc 4:26, Lc 18:11, al.
__8. Ellipses;
__(a) of the copula (Bl., §30, 3): Mt 8:29, 24:32, Jo 21:22, 23, Hb 6:4, al.;
__(b) of the predicate: ἐγώ εἰμί, Mt 14:27, Mc 6:50, al.; absol. (cf. Dt 32:39; אֲנִי הוּא), Mc 13:6, Jo 4:26, al. (cf. ἄπ-, ἔν-, πάρ-, συμ-πάρ-, σύν-ειμι).
(AS)

G1514.def:
εἰρηνεύω
(εἰρήνη), [in LXX chiefly for שׁלם, שׁקט ;]
__1. to bring to peace, reconcile (so 1Ma.6:60).
__2. to keep peace, be at peace: Mc 9:50, Rm 12:18, 2Co 13:11, 1Ts 5:13 (cf. Sir.28:9; Cremer, 246).
† (AS)

G1515.def:
εἰρήνη, -ης, ἡ,
[in LXX chiefly for שָׁלוֹם ;]
peace;
__1. of public peace, freedom from war: Lc 14:32, At 12:20 24:2; of the church, Ac 9:31.
__2. Of peace between persons, concord, agreement : Mt 10:34, Lc 12:51, Rm 14:17, 1Co 7:15, Gl 5:22, Tg 3:18; ζητεῖν εἰ., 1Pe 3:11; διώκειν, 2Tm 2:22; ib. before μετὰ πάντων, Hb 12:14; by meton., of him who brings peace, Ef 2:14.
__3. As in LXX (= Heb. שָׁלוֹם, Aram. שְׁלָם), of a state of security and safety: Jo 16:33, Rm 2:10, 1Ts 5:3,́ whence the formulae, ὕπαγε (πορεύου) εἰς εἰ, Mc 5:34, Lc 7:50 (cf. 1Rs 1:17, al.; לְכִי לְשָׁלוֹם); εἰ. ὑμῖν (שָׁלוֹם לָכֶם), Jo 20:19, 21, 26; ἀπολύειν ἐν εἰ., Lc 2:29, cf. 1Co 16:11; ἡ εἰ. ὑμῶν, Mt 10:13, Lc 10:6; υἱὸς εἰρήνης, ib.
__4. Of spiritual peace, the peace of Christ's kingdom (DCG, ii, 330f.): Lc 1:79 2:14 Jo 16:33, Rm 2:10 5:1 8:6, al.; ὁ κύριος τῆς εἰ., 2Ts 3:16; ὁ θεὸς τῆς εἰ., Rm 15:33 16:20, 2Co 13:11, al.; in epistolary salutations, Rm 1:7, 1Co 1:3, Gl 1:3, 1Ts 1:1, 1Pe 1:2, 2Jo.3, Ap 1:4, al. (see Cremer, 244).
(AS)

G1516.def:
είρηνικός, -ή, -όν
(εἰρήνη), [in LXX for שָׁלוֹם and cognates ;]
peaceful: Hb 12:11, Tg 3:17.†
(AS)

G1519.def:
εἰς,
prep. with accusative,
expressing entrance, direction, limit, into, unto, to, upon, towards, for, among (Lat. in, with accusative).
__I. Of place.
__1. After verbs of motion;
__(a) of entrance into: Mt 8:23, 9:7, Mc 1:45, Lc 2:15, 8:31, al.;
__(b) of approach, to or towards: Mc 11:1, Lc 6:8, 19:28, Jo 11:31, 21:6, al.;
__(with) before pl. and collective nouns, among: Mc 4:7, 8:19, 20, Lc 11:49, Jo 21:23, al.;
__(d) Of a limit reached, unto, on, upon: Mt 8:18, 21:1, Mc 11:1, 13:16, Lc 14:10, Jo 6:3, 11:32, al.; with accusative of person(s) (as in Ep. and Ion.), At 23:15, Rm 5:12, 16:19, 2Co 10:14;
__(e) elliptical: ἐπιστολαὶ εἰς Δαμασκόν, At 9:2; ἡ διακονία μου ἡ εἰς Ἱ., Rm 15:31; metaphorically, of entrance into a certain state or condition, or of approach or direction towards some end (Thayer, B, i, 1; ii, 1), εἰς τ. ὄνομα, M, Pr., 200.
__2. Of direction;
__(a) after verbs of seeing: Mt 6:26, Mc 6:41, Lc 9:16, 62, Jo 13:22, al.; metaphorically, of the mind, Hb 11:26, 12:2, al.;
__(b) after verbs of speaking: Mt 13:10, 14:9, 1Ts 2:9, al.
__3. After verbs of rest;
__(a) in "pregnant" construction, implying previous motion (cl.; see WM, 516; Bl., §39, 3; M, Pr., 234f.): Mt 2:23, 4:13, 2Ts 2:4, 2Tm 1:11, Hb 11:9, al.;
__(b) by an assimilation general in late Gk (see Bl., M, Pr., ll. with) = ἐν: Lc 1:44, 4:23, At 20:16, 21:17, Jo 1:18 (but see Westc, in l.), al.
__II. Of time, for, unto;
__1. accentuating the duration expressed by the accusative: εἰς τ. αἰῶνα, Mt 21:19; εἰς γενεὰς καὶ γ., Lc 1:50; εἰς τ. διηνεκές, Hb 7:3, al.
__2. Of a point or limit of time, unto, up to, until: Mt 6:34, At 4:3, 25:21, Fp 1:10, 2:16, 1Ts 4:15, 2Tm 1:12; of entrance into a future period, σεις τὸ μέλλον (see: μέλλω), next (year), Lc 13:9 (but with ICC, in l.); εἰς τ. μεταξὺ σάββατον, on the next Sabbath, At 13:42; εἰς τὸ πάλιν (see: πάλιν, 2Co 13:2.
__III. Of result, after verbs of changing, joining, dividing, etc.: στρέφειν εἰς, Ap 11:6; μετας-, At 2:20, Tg 4:9; μεταλλάσσειν, Rm 1:26; σχίζειν εἰς δύο, Mt 27:51, al.; predicatively with εἴναι, At 8:23.
__IV. Of relation, to, towards, for, in regard to (so in cl., but more frequently in late Gk., εἰς encroaching on the simple dative, which it has wholly displaced in MGr.; Jannaris, Gr., §1541; Robertson, Gr., 594; Deiss., BS, 117f.): Lc 7:30, Rm 4:20, 15:2, 26, 1Co 16:1, Ef 3:16, al.; ἀγάπη εἰς, Rm 5:8, al.; χρηστός, Ef 4:32; φρονεῖν εἰς, Rm 12:16; θαρρεῖν, 2Co 10:1.
__V. Of the end or object: εὔθετος εἰς, Lc 14:34; σόφος, Rm 16:19; ἰσχύειν, Mt 5:13; εἰς τοῦτο, Mc 1:38, al.; ἀφορίζειν εἰς, Rm 1:1; indicating purpose, εἰς φόβον, Rm 8:15; εἰς ἔνδειξιν, Rm 3:25; εἰς τό, with inf. (= ἵνα or ὥστε; Bl., §71, 5; M, Pr., 218ff.): Mt 20:19, Rm 1:11, 1Co 9:18, al.
__VI. Adverbial phrases: εἰς τέλος, εἰς τὸ πάλιν, etc (see: τέλος, πάλιν, etc.).
(AS)

G1520.def:
εἷς
ιά, ἕν, genitive ἑνός, μιᾶς, ἑνός,
cardinal numeral, one;
__1. one, as opposite to many: Mt 25:15, Rm 5:12, 1Co 10:8, al.; as subst., Rm 5:15, Ef 2:14; id. with genitive partit., Mt 5:19, al.; before ἐκ (ἐξ), Mc 14:18, Jo 6:8, al.; metaphorically, of union and concord, Jo 10:30 17:11, Rm 12:4-5, Fp 1:27; ἀπὸ μιᾶς (B1., § 44, 1), Lc 14:18; with neg., εἷς. . . οὐ (μή), more emphatic than οὐδείς, no one, none (cl.), Mt 5:18 10:29, Lc 11:46 12:6.
__2. Emphatically, to the exclusion of others;
__(a) a single (one): Mt 21:24, Mc 8:14; absol., 1Co 9:24, al.; οὐδὲ εἷς, Mt 27:14, Jo 1:3, Rm 3:10, al.;
__(b) one, alone: Mc 2:7 10:18, Lc 18:19;
__(with) one and the same: Rm 3:30, 1Co 3:8 11:5 12:11, 1Jo 5:8.
__3. In late Gk., with weakened force, = τις or indef. art. (of. Heb. אֶחָד, Gn 22:13, al.; see B1., § 45, 2; M, Pr., 96 f.): Mt 8:19 19:6, Ap 8:13, al.; εἷς τις (Bl., l.with), Lc 22:50, Jo 11:49
__4. Distributively: εἷς καστος (cl.), Lc 4:40, At 2:6, al.; εἷς . . . καὶ εἷς (cl., εἷς μὲν . . . εἷς δέ), Mt 17:4, Mc 9:5, Jo 20:12, al. (cf. LXX and use of Heb. אֶחָד, Êx 17:12, al); ὁ εἷς . . . ὁ ἕτερος (ἄλλος) = cl. ὁ μὲν (ἕτερος) . . . ὁ δέ (ἕτερος), Mt 6:24, Lc 7:41, Ap 17:10; καθ᾽ εἷς, εἷς κ. είς (in which καθ᾽ is adverbial, or the expression formed from the analogy of ἕν καθ᾽ ἔν; M, Pr., 105), one by one, severally: Mc 14:19, Rm 12:5, al.; εἷς τὸν ἕνα = ἀλλήλους (B1., 45, 2; M, Pr., 246), 1Ts 5:11.
__5. As ordinal = πρῶτος (like Heb. אֶחָד; Bl., § 45, 1; M, Pr., 95 f.), first: Mt 28:1, Mc 16:2, al
(AS)

G1521.def:
εἰσ-άγω
[in LXX chiefly for בּוֹא, hi. ;]
to bring in: with accusative, Lc 2:27, Jo 18:16, At 7:45; before εἰς, Lc 22:54, At 9:8 21:28-29, 37 22:24, Hb 1:6; ὧδε, Lc 14:21.†
(AS)

G1522.def:
είσ-ακούω
[in LXX chiefly for שָׁמַע, also for עָנָה, etc. ;]
to listen to, in two senses;
__(a) to obey: 1Co 14:21 (cf. Dt 1:43, Sir.3:6)
__(b) to listen, assent to; pass., to be heard: of persons praying, Mt 6:7, Hb 5:7; of the prayer offered, Lc 1:13, At 10:31 (cf. Sl 4:2, Sir.34:26); see Cremer, 624).†
(AS)

G1524.def:
εἴσ-ειμι
[in LXX for בּוֹא ;]
to go in, enter: before εἰς, At 3:3 21:26, Hb 9:6; πρὸς Ἰάκωβον, At 21:18.†
(AS)

G1525.def:
εἰσ-έρχομαι,
[in LXX chiefly for בּוֹא ;]
to go in or into, enter: Mt 9:25, Lc 7:45, al.; before εἰς, Mt 10:12, Mc 2:1, al.; before διά (πύλης, θύρας, etc.), Mt 7:13, Jo 10:1, al.; ὑπὸ τ. στέγην, Mt 8:8; with adv.: ὅπου, Mc 14:14, Hb 6:20; ὧδε, Mt 22:12; ἔσω, Mt 26:58; before πρός, with accusative of person(s), Mc 15:43, Lc 1:28, At 10:3 11:3 16:40 17:2 28:8, Ap 3:20; of demons taking possession, Mc 9:25, Lc 8:30 22:3, Jo 13:27; of food, Mt 15:11, At 11:8. Metaphorical, of thoughts, Lc 9:46; εἰς κόπον, Jo 4:38; εἰς πειρασμόν, Mt 26:41, Lc 22:40, 46; of hope as an anchor, Hb 6:19; βοαί, Tg 5:4; πνεῦμα ζωῆς, Ap 11:11; εἰς τ. κόσμον (cf. Wis.2:24 14:14, Jo 18:37), Rm 5:12, Hb 10:5; in counterparts of Jewish Aram. phrases relating to the theocracy (cf. Dalman, Words, 116ff.): εἰς τ. γάμους, Mt 25:10; εἰς τ. χάραν τ. κυρίου, Mt 25:21, 23; εἰς τ. ζωήν, Mt 18:8, 9 19:17, Mc 9:43, 45; εἰς τ. βασιλ. τ. οὐρανῶν, Mt 5:20 7:21, al. (see: βασιλεία); εἰς τ. κατάπαυσιν, Hb 3:11, 18 4:1ff.; εἰς τ. δόξαν, Lc 24:26; εἰσ. καὶ ἐξερχ., to go in and out (like Heb. בוֹא וְצֵאת, Dt 28:6, etc.), of familiar intercourse, At 1:21; figuratively, of moral freedom, Jo 10:9 (cf. ἐπ-, παρ-, συν-εισέρχομαι).
(AS)

G1528.def:
εἰσ-καλέω, -ῶ,
to call in: mid., with accusative of person(s), At 10:23.†
(AS)

G1529.def:
εἴσ-οδος, -ου, ὁ
(ὁδός) [in LXX chiefly for בּוֹא ;]
__1. a means of entering, place of entrance: Hb 10:19, 2Pe 1:11 (cf. Westc., He., l.with; MM, Exp., xii; but see infr.).
__2. a going in, entrance: At 13:24; with genitive loc., Hb 10:19 (Thayer, see word; but see supr.); before εἰς, 2Pe 1:11 (Mayor, in l.; Thayer; but see supr.); πρός, 2Ts 1:9 2:1.†
(AS)

G1530.def:
εἰσ-πηδάω, -ῶ
[in LXX: Am 5:19 (בּוֹא), Da TH Sus 1:26* ;]
to spring in, rush in: At 14:14 (Rec.), At 16:29 (for exx. from π., see MM, Exp., xii).†
(AS)

G1531.def:
εἰσ-πορεύομαι
[in LXX chiefly for בּוֹא ;]
to go into, enter: Lc 8:16 11:33 19:30; before εἰς, Mc 1:21 6:56 11:2, Lc 22:10, At 3:2; πρός, with accusative of person(s), At 28:30; ὅπου, Mc 5:40; κατά τ. οἴκους, house after house, At 8:3; of things (food), Mt 15:17, Mc 7:15, 18-19 Metaphorical (cf. εἰοέρχομαι, 2), Mc 4:19, Lc 18:24; εἰσ. καὶ ἐκπορ., to associate with, before μετά (cf. εἰσέρχομαι), At 9:28.†
(AS)

G1533.def:
εἰσ-φέρω
[in LXX chiefly for בּוֹא hi. ;]
to bring in, into: with accusative of person(s), Lc 5:18-19; before εἰς, Mt 6:13, Lc 11:4; ἐπί, Lc 12:11; with accusative of thing(s), before εἰς, 1Tm 6:7; pass., Hb 13:11.†
(AS)

G1534.def:
εἶτα
adv.,
denoting sequence;
__1. of time; then, next: Mc 8:25, Lc 8:12, Jo 13:5 19:27 20:27, 1Tm 3:10, Tg 1:15; before genitive abs., Mc 4:17; in enumerations, 1Co 15:5 15:7 15:24, 1Tm 2:13.
__2. In argument;
__(a) therefore, then,
__(b) furthermore: Hb 12:9 (cf. εἶτεν).†
(AS)

G1535.def:
εἴτε, see: εἰ.
εἰ,
conjunctive particle, used in conditions and in indirect questions.
__I. Conditional, if;
__1. with indic, expressing a general assumption;
__(a) pres.: before indic, pres., Mt 11:14, Rm 8:25, al.; before imperat., Mc 4:23 9:22, Jo 15:18, 1Co 7:9, al.; before fut. indic., Lc 16:31, Rm 8:11, al.; before pf. or aor., with negation in apodosis, Mt 12:26, Rm 4:14, al.; similarly, before impf., Lc 17:6, Jo 8:39; before quæst., Mt 6:23, Jo 5:47 7:23 8:46, 1Pe 2:20;
__(b) fut.: Mt 26:33, 1Pe 2:20;
__(with) pf.: Jo 11:12, Rm 6:5, al.;
__(d) aor.: Lc 16:11 19:8, Jo 13:32, 18:23, Ap 20:15, al.
__2. Where the assumption is certain = ἐπεί: Mt 12:28, Jo 7:4, Rm 5:17, al.
__3. Of an unfulfilled condition, with indic, impf., aor. or plpf., before ἄν, with imp. or aor. (see: ἄν, I, i).
__4. C. indic., after verbs denoting wonder, etc., sometimes, but not always, coupled with an element of doubt: Mc 15:44, 1Jo 3:13, al.
__5. C. indic., as in LXX (Nm 14:3o, 1Rs 14:45, al. = Heb. אִם), in oaths, with the formula of imprecation understood in a suppressed apodosis (WM, 627; Burton, §272): Mc 8:12, Hb 3:11" (LXX) 4:3 (LXX).
__6. Rarely (cl.) with optative, to express a merely possible condition: At 24:19 27:39, 1Co 14:10 15:37, I Pe3:14, 17.
__II. Interrogative, if, whether.
__1. As in cl., in indir. questions after verbs of seeing, asking, knowing, saying, etc.: with indic. pres., Mt 26:63, Mc 15:36, At 19:2, 2Co 13:5, al.; fut., Mc 3:2, At 8:22, al.; aor., Mc 15:44, 1Co 1:16, al.; with subjc. aor. (M, Pr., 194), Fp 3:12.
__2. As in LXX (= Heb. אִם and interrog. הֲ, Gn 17:17, al.; see WM, 639f.; Viteau, i, 22), in direct questions: Mc 8:23 (Tr., WH, txt.), Lc 13:23, 22:49, At 19:2, al.
__III. With other particles.
__1. εἰ ἄρα, εἴγε, εἰ δὲ μήγε, see: ἄρα, γε.
__2. εἰ δὲ καί, but if also: Lc 11:18; but even if, 1Co 4:7, 2Co 4:3 11:16.
__3. εἰ δὲ μή, but if not, but if otherwise: Mc 2:21, 22 Jo 14:2, Ap 2:5, al.
__4. εἰ καί, if even, if also, although: Mc 14:29, Lc 11:8, 1Co 7:21, 2Co 4:16, Fp 2:17, al.
__5. καὶ εἰ, even if, see: καί
__6. εἰ μή, if not, unless, except, but only: Mt 24:22, Mc 2:26 6:5, Jo 9:33, 1Co 7:17 (only), Gl 1:19 (cf. ἐὰν μή, 2:16; see Hort., Ja., xvi); ἐκτὸς εἰ μή, pleonastic (Bl., §65, 6), 1Co 14:5 15:2, 1Tm 5:19.
__7. εἰ μήν = cl. ἦ μήν (M, Pr., 46), in oaths, surely (Eze.33:27, al.): Hb 6:14.
__8. εἴ πως, if haply: At 27:12, Rm 1:10.
__9. εἴτε . . . εἴτε, whether . . . or; Rm 12:6-8, 1Co 3:22 13:8, al.
(AS)

G1537.def:
ἐκ (ἐξ),
prep. with genitive,
from out of, from (see Addendum, p. 492).
This entry is included here, but in the print version the entry is found on p. 492. ἐκ, before a vowel ἐξ,
prep. with genitive,
of motion outwards, separation from (opposite to εἰς; = Lat. e, ex), from out of, from among, from.
__I. Of Place,
__1. of motion, out of, forth from, off from: Jo 6:31, At 9:3, Gl 1:8, al.; esp. after verbs of motion, Mt 8:28 17:9, Mc 1:25 7:28, Jo 1:33 20:1, At 12:7, 17 27:30, al.; constr. praeg., σώζειν (διας) ἐκ, Ju 5, At 28:4. Metaphorical, Mt 7:4, 5, 1Pe 2:9; ἐκ τ. χειρός (-ῶν), before genitive of person(s), Lc 1:74, Jo 10:28, 29, 39, At 12:4 24:7, Ap 19:2; πίνειν (which see) ἐκ; of the place from which an action proceeds, Lc 5:3 (cf. 12:36, Jo 13:4, 2Co 2:4).
__2. Of change from one place or condition to another: Jo 8:42, Rm 6:13 13:11, Ap 7:14, al.; with ellips. of verb of motion, 2Tm 2:26, 2Pe 2:21, Ap 2:21, al.
__3. Of separation or distinction from a number, before collective or pl. nouns: Mt 13:47, 49, Jo 12:1, At 3:15, 1Pe 1:3, al.; after εἷς, Mt 10:29 Lc 17:15, al.; οὐδείς, Jo 7:19, al.; πολλοί, Jo 11:19, al.; τις, Lc 11:15, al.; τίς, Mt 6:27, al.; in partitive phrase as subject of sentence, Jo 16:17; Hebraistically, ἐκ μέσου before genitive, = ἐκ (Heb. מִתּוֹךְ), Mt 13:49, al.
__4. Of position or direction (so in cl. = ἔξω): ἐκ δεξιῶν (see: δεξιός); ἐξ ἐναντίας, Mc 15:39 (metaphorically, Tt 2:8); ἐκ ῥιζῶν (i.e., utterly), Mt 11:20.
__II. Of Time,
__1. of the point of time from which, from, since: ἐκ γενετῆς, Jo 9:1, cf. Mc 10:20, Lc 23:8, At 24:10, al.
__2. Of succession in time: ἐκ δευτέρου, a second time, Mc 14:72, al., cf. Mt 26:44; ἡμέραν ἐξ ἡμέρας, from day to day, 2Pe 2:8.
__III. Of Origin,
__1. of nativity, lineage, race: κοίτην (ἐν γαστρί) ἔχειν, Rm 9:10, Mt 1:18; γεννᾶν ἐκ, Mt 1:3ff.; γεννᾶσθαι (γίνεσθαι) ἐκ, Jo 3:6 8:41, Gl 4:4; ἐκ πνεύματος (θεοῦ), Jo 1:13 3:5ff., al. ἔρχεσθαι, εἶναι, etc., ἐκ τ. πολέως, Jo 1:44; φυλῆς, Lc 2:36, al.; τ. ἐξουσίας Ἡρῴδου, Lc 23:7; ὁ ὢν ἐκ τ. γῆς, Jo 3:31.
__2. Of the author, occasion or source: Mt 5:37, Jo 2:16, Rm 2:29, 1Co 8:6, Gl 5:8, al.; ἐκ (τ. θεοῦ, 1Co 7:7, 2Co 5:1, 1Jo 4:7; ἐκ τ. πατρός, Jo 6:65, al.; ἐκ τ. γῆς ἐστιν, λαλεῖ, Jo 3:31; εκ καρδίας, Rm 6:17, cf. Mc 12:30, 1Tm 1:5; ἐκ ψυχῆς, Ef 6:6, Cl 3:23; ἐκ πίστεως, Rm 14:23; κρίνειν ἐκ, Lc 19:22, Ap 20:12.
__3. Of the agent, after passive verbs: Mt 15:5, Mc 7:11, 2Co 2:2, al.; frequently in Re after αδικεῖσθαι (2:11), etc.
__4. Of cause, dependence, source of supply: τ. πόνου (των), Ap 16:10, 11; τ. φωνῶν, Ap 8:13; ἐκ τούτου, Jo 6:66 19:12 (but see Meyer, in ll.); ἐκ θεοῦ λαλεῖν, 2Co 2:17; ἐκ τ. ἀληθείας, Jo 18:37, 1Jo 3:19; ὁ ἐκ πίστεως, Rm 3:26 4:16; οἱ (ὄντες) ἐκ περιτομῆς, At 11:2, Rm 4:12, Gl 2:12, Cl 4:11; πίνειν ἐκ, Mt 26:29, Mc 14:25, Jo 4:13, al.; θερίζειν, Gl 6:8; μετέχειν ἐκ (= partit. genitive), 1Co 10:13; with inf., ἐκ τοῦ ἔχειν, 2Co 8:11.
__5. Of material: Mt 27:29, Jo 2:15 19:2, Rm 9:21, 1Co 11:12, Ap 18:12, al.; allied to which is its use of price (= cl. genitive): Mt 27:7, cf. ib. 20:2, At 1:18.
__IV. By attraction = ἐν (cl.): τὰ ἐκ τ. οἰκιας, Mt 24:17; τ. ἐξ αὐτοῦ δύναμιν, Mc 5:30 (see Field, in l.); ὁ πατὴρ ὁ ἐξ οὐρανοῦ, Lc 11:13.
__V. Adverbial phrases: ἐξ ἀνάγκης, 2Co 9:7, Hb 7:12; ἐξ ἰσότητος, 2Co 8:13; ἐκ μέρους, 1Co 12:27 13:9-12; ἐκ μέτρου, Jo 3:34; ἐκ συμφώνου, 1Co 7:5.
__VI. in composition, ἐκ signifies,
__1. procession, removal: ἐκβαίνω, ἐκβάλλω.
__2. Opening out, unfolding: ἐκτείνω; metaphorically, ἐξαγγάλλω.
__3. Origin: ἔκγονος.
__4. Completeness: ἐξαπορέω (see M, Pr., 237), ἐκπληρόω, ἐκτελέω.
(AS)

G1538.def:
1. every, every one, each, each one , Lat. quisque, (Homer), etc.; the singular is often joined with a pl. Verb, ἔβαν οἴκονδε ἕκαστος they went home every one of them , (Iliad by Homer); ἕκαστος ἐπίστασθε (Xenophon Historicus):—;the singular is also put in apposition with a pl. Noun, Τρῶας ἕκαστον ὑπήλυθε τρόμος (for Τρώων ἕκαστον)) fear seized them every one , (Iliad by Homer)
2. in plural all and each one , (Homer)
3. more definitely, εἷς ἕκαστος, Lat. unusquisque, every single one, (Herdotus Historicus), etc.:—; καθ᾽ ἕκαστον singly, by itself , Lat. singulatim, (Plato Philosophus), etc.
4. ὡς ἕκαστοι each by himself , (Herdotus Historicus), etc. (ML)

G1540.def:
ἑκατόν, οἱ, αἱ, τά
indecl.,
a hundred: Mt 13:8, 23 Lc 15:4, al.; κατὰ ἑ, Mc 6:40; εἰς, ἐν ἑ., Mc 4:8, 20
(AS)

G1541.def:
ἑκατονταετής (Rec. έτης), -ές
(ἑκατόν, ἔτης) [in LXX for שָׁנֶה מֵאָה בֵּן, Gn 17:17 * ;]
a hundred years old: Rm 4:19.†
(AS)

G1542.def: a hundred times as much or many , (Xenophon Historicus) (ML)

G1544.def:
ἐκ-βάλλω
[in LXX chiefly for גָּרַשׁ pi., also for שָׁלַךְ hi., יָצָא hi., יָרַשׁ hi., etc. ;]
__1. to drive, cast or send out, to expel: with accusative of thing(s), mid. (σῖτον), before εἰς, At 27:38; pass., Mt 15:17; with accusative of person(s), Mt 21:12, Mc 11:15, al.; δαιμόνια, Mt 7:22, Mc 1:34, al.; id. before ἐκ, Mc 7:26; παρά, Mc 16:9; ἐν, Mc 3:22; (ἐν) τ. ὀνόματι, Mt 7:22, Mc 9:38; λόγῳ, Mt 8:16; before ἔξω, Jo 6:37; id. with genitive, Mc 12:8, al.; of expulsion from home, Gl 4:30; from the Church, III Jn 10.
__2. In LXX and NT (like Heb. יָצָא and Aram. הַנְפֵּק), to command or cause to depart: Mt 9:38, Mc 1:12 (see Swete, in l.), ib. Mc 1:43 5:40, Lc 10:2, Tg 2:25; τ. κρίσιν εἰς νῖκος (to cause to proceed to its goal), Mt 12:20 (LXX).
__3. to reject (cl.): τ. ὄνομα ὑμῶς ὡς πονηρόν (cf. Dt 25:14), Lc 6:22; to leave out, Ap 11:2.
__4. to take, draw or pluck out;
__(a) with violence: Mt 7:5, Mc 9:47, Lc 6:42;
__(b) to bring forth or out of: Mt 12:35, Lc 10:35.
(AS)

G1545.def:
ἔκ-βασις, -εως, ἡ
(ἐκβαίνω), [in LXX: Wis.2:17 8:8 11:14 * ;]
__1. a way out (Hom., Xen.): 1Co 10:13.
__2. the issue (Menand.) Hb 13:7.†
(AS)

G1546.def:
ἐκ-βολή, -ῆς
(ἐκβάλλω), [in LXX: Êx 11:1 (גָּרַשׁ), Js 1:5 (ἐκβολὴν ποιεῖσθαι, טול hi.), Eze.47:8 (יָצָא)* ;]
__1. a throwing out.
__2. a jettison, a throwing overboard of cargo: At 27:18 (cf. Jos, l.with; and see Field, Notes, 144 f.).†
(AS)

G1549.def:
ἔκ-γονος, -ον
(ἐκγίγνομαι, to be born of), [in LXX for פְּרִי (neut.), בֵּן, etc. ;]
__1. with genitive, born of.
__2. As subst., ὁ, ἡ ἔ., a child, son or daughter; in pl., descendants: τέκνα ἢ ἔ., children or grand-children, 1Tm 5:4.†
(AS)

G1550.def:
εκ-δαπανάω, -ῶ
strengthened form of δαπανάω, to spend wholly; pass., with reflexive force, to spend oneself wholly: before ὑπέρ, 2Co 12:15.†
(AS)

G1551.def:
ἐκ-δέχομαι
[in LXX for עֶרֶב, קָבַץ, etc. ;]
__1. to take or receive from (Hom., Hdt., a1.).
__2. (Rare in cl.), to expect, await: with accusative of thing(s), Jo 5:3, Hb 11:10, Tg 5:7; with accusative of person(s), At 17:16, 1Co 11:33 16:11; before ἕως, Hb 10:13 (Cremer, 687).†
(AS)

G1552.def:
ἔκ-δηλος, -ον
(δῆλος), [in LXX: 3Ma.3:19 3Mac 6:5 * ;]
strengthened form of δῆλος, which see, quite clear, evident: 2Tm 3:9.†
(AS)

G1553.def:
ἐκ-δημέω, -ῶ
(ἔκδημος, from home; cf. -ία, 3Ma.4:11)*;
to be from home, absent: 2Co 5:6; before ἀπό, 2Co 5:8; before ἐκ, 2Co 5:9 (cf. ἀπο-, ἐνδημέω).†
(AS)

G1554.def:
ἐκ-δίδωμι
[in LXX for נָתַן, etc. ;]
__1. to surrender, give up, give out.
__2. to let out for hire (Hdt.); mid. (as frequently in π.; see MM, Exp., xii); to let out to one's advantage, Mt 21:33, 41, Mc 12:1, Lc 20:9.†
(AS)

G1555.def:
ἐκ-δι-ηγέομαι, -οῦμαι depon.,
[in LXX chiefly for סָפַר, pi. ;]
to tell in detail, relate, declare: At 13:41 (LXX) At 15:3.†
(AS)

G1556.def:
ἐκδικέω, -ῶ
(ἔκδικος), [in LXX for פָּקַד, נָקַם, שָׁפַט, etc. ;]
__1. to vindicate: with accusative of person(s), Lc 18:3, 5.
__2. to avenge: with accusative of person(s), ἑαυτούς, Rm 12:19; with accusative of thing(s), παρακοήν, 2Co 10:6; αἷμα, Ap 6:10 19:2 (Cremer, 203; for exx. from π. in both senses, see MM, Exp., xii).†
(AS)

G1557.def:
ἐκ-δίκησις, -εως, ἡ
(ἐκδικέω), [in LXX chiefly for נָקָם ;]
vengeance, vindication: Lc 21:22, Rm 12:19 (see MM, Exp., xii), Hb 10:30 (LXX), 2Co 7:11; of the injured person, with genitive, Lc 18:7-8; with dative, At 7:24; of the offender, with genitive obj., 1Pe 2:14; with dative, 2Ts 1:8 (cf. Sir.12:6).†
(AS)

G1558.def:
ἔκδικος, -ον
(δίκη), [in LXX: Wis.12:12, Sir.30:6, 4Ma.15:29 * ;]
__1. without law, unjust.
__2. exacting penalty from; as subst., an avenger: Rm 13:4; before περί, 1Ts 4:6 (in π., a legal representative; Milligan, Th., l.with).†
(AS)

G1559.def:
ἐκ-διώκω
[in LXX for בָּרַח hi., צָמַת, הָדַף, etc. ;]
to chase away, drive out: 1Ts 2:15 (cf. Dt 6:19, Jl 2:20).†
(AS)

G1560.def:
ἔκ-δοτος, -ον
(ἐκδίδωμι), [in LXX: Da TH Bel 1:22 * ;]
given up, delivered over: At 2:23 (for construction, see Field, Notes, 111 f.).†
(AS)

G1561.def:
ἐκ-δοχή ῆς, ἡ
(ἐκδέχομαι);
__1. in cl.,
__(a) a receiving from, succession;
__(b) an interpretation.
__2. In NT, = προσδοκία, expectation: Hb 10:27 (cf. Field, Notes, 231; Cremer, 688).†
(AS)

G1562.def:
ἐκ-δύω
[in LXX chiefly for פָּשַׁט ;]
to take of, strip of, strip: with accusative of person(s) (sc. clothing), Mt 27:28; with accusative of person(s) and of thing(s), Mt 27:31, Mc 15:20, Lc 10:30; mid., to put off: figuratively, of the body, 2Co 5:4.†
(AS)

G1563.def:
ἐκεῖ
adv., [in LXX chiefly for שָׁם ;]
__1. properly, of place, there: Mt 2:13 5:24, al.; οἱ ἐ., Mt 26:71; οὗ . . . ἐ., Mt 6:21 18:20 24:28, Mc 6:10, Lc 12:34; pleonastic, ὅπου . . . ἐ. (= שָׁם אֲשֶׁר, Dt 4:5, al.), Ap 12:6, 14 (cf. Bl., § 50, 4).
__2. As often in cl. (Hdt., Thuc., al.), with verbs of motion, for ἐκεῖσε, thither: Mt 2:22 17:20 24:28 26:36, Mc 6:33, Lc 12:18 17:37 21:2, Jo 11:8 18:2-3, Rm 15:24
(AS)

G1564.def:
ἐκεῖθεν
adv., [in LXX chiefly for שָׁם ;]
__1. of place, thence: Mt 4:21, Mc 6:1, al.
__2. Of time, thereafter (see: κἀκεῖθεν).
(AS)

G1565.def:
ἐκεῖνος, -η, -ο
(ἐκεῖ), [in LXX chiefly for הַהוּא ,הוּא, and cogn. forms ;]
demonstr. pron.,
that person or thing (ille), implying remoteness as compared with οὗτος (hic);
__1. absol., emphatic he, she, it: opposite to οὗτος, Lc 18:14, Tg 4:15; ἡμεῖς, Hb 12:25; ὑμεῖς, Mc 4:11; ἄλλοι, Jo 9:9; ἐγώ, Jo 3:30; to persons named, Mk 16:[10, 13, 20], Jo 2:21; of one (absent) who is not named, contemptuously (Abbott, JG, §§2385, 2732), Jo 7:11 9:28; with respect, of Christ, 1Jo.2:6 3:3, al.; referring to a preceding noun, Mrk.16:[10], Jo 7:45; resumption of a participial subject, Jo 1:33 9:37 10:1, Rm 14:14, al. (on its reference in Jo 19:35, see Westc, in l.; Moffatt, Intr., 568; Sanday, Fourth Gospel, 77ff.).
__2. As adj., joined, like οὗτος, to a noun with the article: Mt 7:25, Mc 3:24, Jo 18:15, al.; esp. of time, past or future: ἐν τ. ἡμέραις ἐ., Mt 3:1, Mc 1:9, At 2:18" (LXX), al.; ἐν ἐ. τ. ἡμέρᾳ, esp of the Parousia, Mt 7:22, Lc 6:23, 2Ts 1:10, 2Tm 1:12; adverbially, ἐκεινής (sc. ὁδοῦ) = cl. ἐκεινῇ (Bl., §36, 13), that way, Lc 19:4.
(AS)

G1566.def:
ἐκεῖσε
adv., [in LXX: Jó 39:29 שָׁם * ;]
thither: At 21:3; constr. pregn. (MM, Exp., xii; Field, Notes, 134), τοὺς ἐ. ὄντας, At 22:5.†
(AS)

G1567.def:
ἐκ-ζητέω, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for דָּרַשׁ, also for נָצַר, בָּקַשׁ, etc. ;]
__1. to seek out or after, search for: with accusative of person(s) (1Ma.9:26); figuratively, τ. κύριον, θεόν (cf. Sl 14:2, Am 5:4, al.), At 15:17, Rm 3:11, Hb 11:6; εὐλογίαν, Hb 12:17; ἐξεζήτησαν κ. ἐξηραύνησαν (as in 1Ma.9:26), sought and searched out: 1Pe 1:10.
__2. As in 2Rs 4:11, Eze.3:18, 20 al. (דָּרַשׁ), to demand, require: Lc 11:50-51 †
(AS)

G1568.def:
ἐκ-θαμβέω, -ῶ
(ἔκθαμβος), [in LXX: Sir.30:9 * ;]
__1. to be amazed.
__2. to amaze, terrify (Sir.30:9). Pass., to be amazed, terrified: Mc 9:15 14:33 16:5-6.†
(AS)

G1569.def:
ἔκ-θαμβος, -ον
(θάμβος), [in LXX: Wis.10:19, Da TH Dn 7:7 (dreadful, terrible: אֵמְתָּנִי) * ;]
amazed (cf. Polyb., xx, 10, 9): At 3:11.†
(AS)

G1570.def:
ἔκ-θετος, -ον
(ἐκτίθημι), [in Al.: Eze.42:3 * ;]
cast out: ποιεῖν ἔ. = ἐκτιθέναι, At 7:19.†
(AS)

G1571.def:
ἐκ-καθαίρω
[in LXX for בָּעַר, etc. ;]
__1. to cleanse thoroughly, cleanse out: with accusative, ἑαυτόν, 2Tm 2:21; of the impurity removed, ζυμήν, 1Co 5:7.†
(AS)

G1572.def:
ἐκ-καίω
[in LXX chiefly for בָּעַר ;]
__1. to burn up.
__2. to kindle. Pass., to burn: metaphorically, of the passions (cf. Sir.16:6, Jó 3:17), Rm 1:27.†
(AS)

G1573.def:
ἐκκακέω, -ῶ, see: ἐνκακέω.
ἐν-κακέω, -ῶ (LTr., ἐγκ-; Rec. ἐκκ-; cf. WH, Notes, 157 f.; κακός, cowardly),
[in Sm.: Gn 27:46, Nm 21:5, Pv 3:11, Is 7:16 *;]
to lose heart : Lc 18:1, 2Co 4:1,16, Gl 6:9, Ef 3:13, 2Ts 3:13 (Cremer, 330).†
(AS)

G1574.def:
ἐκ-κεντέω, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for דָּקַר ;]
__1. to prick out, put out (Arist.).
__2. to pierce (Polyb., LXX): with accusative of person(s), Jo 19:37 (LXX), Ap 1:7.†
(AS)

G1575.def:
ἐκ-κλάω, -ῶ
[in LXX: Lv 1:17 (שָׁסַע pi.)* ;]
to break off: pass., Rm 11:17-20.†
(AS)

G1576.def:
ἐκ-κλείω
[in LXX: ἐ. κρίσιν, for נָטָה hi., Êx 23:2 (also as seel., Jó 34:20, Sl 67:1-7 (Sl 68:30) * ;]
to shut out: Gl 4:17. Pass., Rm 3:27.†
(AS)

G1577.def:
ἐκκλησία, -ας, ἡ
(ἐκ-καλέω), [in LXX chiefly for קָהָל, otherwise for one of its cogn. forms ;]
__1. prop., an assembly of citizens regularly convened (in Thuc., ii, 22, opposite to σύλλογος, a concourse): At 19:32, 39 41.
__2. In LXX of the assembly, congregation, community of Israel (Dt 4:10 23:2, al.): At 7:38, Hb 2:12" (LXX) .
__3. NT, esp. of an assembly or company of Christians, a (the) church;
__(a) of gatherings for worship: 1Co 11:18 14:19, 34 35;
__(b) of local communities: At 8:3, 1Co 4:17; with name added, At 8:1, Rm 16:1, 1Ts 1:1, al.; pl., At 15:41, 1Co 7:17; τ. Χριστοῦ, Rm 16:16; τ. Ἀσίας, 1Co 16:19; τ. ἁγίων, 1Co 14:33; εἰπο]ν τ. ἐκκλησίᾳ, Mt 18:17 (but see Hort, Ecclesia, 10); of a house-congregation (DB, i, 431a), Rm 16:5, 1Co 16:19, Cl 4:15, Phm 2;
__(with) of the whole body of Christians: Mt 16:18, 1Co 12:28, Ef 1:22, Fp 3:6, al.; τ. θεοῦ, At 20:28 (Κυρίου, T, R, mg.), 1Co 15:9, Gl 1:13, 1Tm 3:15; ἐ. προτοτόκων ἀπογεγραμμένων ἐν οὐρανοῖς, Hb 12:23.
SYN.: συναγωγή, which see (see Tr., Syn., §i; DB, i, 426; Hort, Ecclesia, esp. 4ff., 107ff.; Hamilton, People of God, ii, 37ff.; reff. s.vv. "Church," "Congregation," in DB and DCG; Cremer, 332). (AS)

G1578.def:
ἐκ-κλίνω
[in LXX for נָטָה, סוּר, etc. ;]
intrans., to turn aside, turn away: metaphorically, from the right path, absol., Rm 3:12 (LXX); from evil, absol., 1Pe 3:11; before ἀπό, with genitive of person(s), Rm 16:17.†
(AS)

G1580.def:
ἐκ-κομίζω
to carry out: as freq., a corpse for burial, Lc 7:12.†
(AS)

G1581.def:
ἐκ-κόπτω,
[in LXX for כָּרַת, etc. ;]
to cut out, cut off, cut down: of a hand, foot, Mt 5:30 18:8; a tree, Mt 3:10 7:19 Lc 3:9 13:7, 9; figuratively, of a branch, Rm 11:22; before ἐκ, Rm 11:24; metaphorically, τ. ἀφορμήν (cf. Jó 19:10 ἐλπίδα), 2Co 11:12.†
(AS)

G1582.def:
ἐκ-κρέμαννυμι,
[in LXX for קָשַׁר, Gn 44:30 * ;]
to hang from or upon; mid., ἐκκρέμαμαι: figuratively, ἐξεκρέματο αὐτοῦ άκούων (Rec.; WH read ἐξεκρέμετο, which implies a Pres. ἐκκρέμομαι, otherwise unknown; cf. Veitch, see word κρέμαμαι), Lc 19:48.†
(AS)

G1583.def:
ἐκ-λαλέω, -ῶ
[in LXX: Jdth.11:9 * ;]
to speak out, divulge: At 23:22.†
(AS)

G1584.def:
ἐκ-λάμπω
[in LXX for אוֹר hi., etc. ;]
to shine forth: Mt 13:43.†
(AS)

G1585.def:
ἐκ-λανθάνω
[in Sm.: Sl 13:2 * ;]
to escape notice utterly; mid., to forget utterly: Hb 12:5.†
(AS)

G1586.def:
ἐκ-λέγω
[in LXX chiefly for בָּחַר ;]
to pick out, choose. In NT always mid. (exc. Lc 9:35, ἐκλελεγμένος, WH, ἀγαπητός, R, mg.), to pick out for oneself, choose (cf. M, Pr., 157 f.): with accusative of thing(s), Lc 10:42 14:7; with accusative of person(s), At 6:5 15:22, 25; of Christ (see supr.), Lc 9:35; of Christ's choice of disciples, Lc 6:13, Jo 6:70 13:18 15:16, 19 At 1:2; of the Divine choice: of persons, Mc 13:20, At 1:24 13:17 15:7, Ef 1:4, Tg 2:5; of things, 1Co 1:27-28 (Cremer, 402, 773).†
(AS)

G1587.def:
ἐκ-λείπω
[in LXX for כָּלָה, כָּרַת ni., תָּמַם, etc., 47 different words in all ;]
__1. trans., to leave out, pass over.
__2. Intrans., to leave off, cease, fail: μαμωνᾶς, Lc 16:9; πίστις, Lc 22:32; ἔτη, Hb 1:12 (LXX); of the sun in an eclipse, Lc 23:45.†
(AS)

G1588.def:
ἐκ-λεκτός, -ή, -όν
(ἐκλέγω), [in LXX for בָּחַר (so prob. in Is 28:16, Pv 17:3, for MT בָּחַן), בָּרִיא, etc. ;]
__1. choice, select (cl., rarely; Thuc., Plat., al.), hence, eminent: Rm 16:13 (cf. Eze.27:24).
__2. As in Inscr. (MM, Exp., xii), chosen; esp. as in LXX, of Israel, elect, chosen of God (Is 65:9, Sl 105:43, al.); so in NT;
__(a) of Christ: Lc 23:35 (cf. Is 42:1); figuratively, λίθος, 1Pe 2:4-6 (LXX);
__(b) of holy angels: 1Tm 5:21;
__(with) of Christians: Mt 24:22, 24, Mc 13:20, 22 13:27, 2Tm 2:10, 1Pe 1:1; τ. θεοῦ, Lc 18:7, Rm 8:33, Cl 3:12, Tt 1:1; τ. Χριστοῦ, Mt 24:31; ἐ. κυρία, II Jn 1; ἀδελφή, II Jn 13; γένος, 1Pe 2:9 (LXX); κλητοὶ καὶ ἐ. κ. πιστοί, Ap 17:14; opposite to κλητός (not so in Epp.; see Lft. on Cl 3:12), Mt 20:16 (T, WH, txt., R, omit) Mt 22:14 (Cremer, 405, 775).†
(AS)

G1589.def:
ἐκλογή, ῆς ἡ
(ἐκλέγω), [in Aq.: Is 22:7; Sm., Th.: Is 37:24 * ;]
a choice, selection; in NT, always of the Divine choice (EV, election): σκεῦος ἐκλογῆς, genitive qual., a chosen vessel; κατ ἐ., Rm 9:11 11:5, 28; with genitive of person(s), 1Ts 1:4, 2Pe 1:10; by meton., ἡ ἐ. = οἱ ἐκλεκτοί, Rm 11:7.†
(AS)

G1590.def:
ἐκ-λύω
[in LXX for רָפָה, etc. ;]
__1. to loose, release.
__2. to unloose, as a bow-string, to relax, enfeeble; pass., to be faint, grow weary: Mt 15:32, Mc 8:3; of mental weariness, Gl 6:9, Hb 12:3, 5" (LXX) .†
(AS)

G1591.def:
ἐκ-μάσσω
[in LXX: Sir.12:11, Ep. Jr 13:1-27 24:1-10 * ;]
to wipe off: with accusative, Lc 7:38, 44, Jo 11:2 12:3 13:5.†
(AS)

G1592.def:
ἐκ-μυκτηρίζω
[in LXX: Sl 2:4 22:7 35:16 (לָעַג), I Et 1:51 A* ;]
to hold up the nose in derision at, scoff at: with accusative, Lc 16:14 23:35.†
(AS)

G1593.def:
ἐκ-νεύω
[in LXX: Jz 4:18 (סוּר) Jz 18:26, 4Ki.2:24 23:16 (פָּנָה), Mq 6:14 (סוּג hi.), 3Ma.3:22 * ;]
__1. to bend the head aside (Xen.).
__2.
__(a) to shun, avoid (Diod.);
__(b) to withdraw: Jo 5:13†
(AS)

G1594.def:
ἐκ-νήφω
[in LXX: Gn 9:24, Hc 2:7 (יָקַץ), Jl 1:5, Hc 2:19 (יָקַץ hi.), 1Rs 25:37 (יָצָא), Sir.31:2 * ;]
to become sober after drunkenness: metaphorically, of sobriety of mind, 1Co 15:34.†
(AS)

G1595.def:
ἐκούσιος, -ον
(έκών), [in LXX chiefly for נְדָבָה, as Nm 15:3 (κατ᾽ ἑ) ;]
usually of actions, voluntary: κατὰ ἑ., of free will (Lft., in l), Phm 14.†
(AS)

G1597.def:
ἔκ-παλαι
adv. (of a class of compound adverbs common in late Gk.; see Mayor on 2 Pe, l.with),
for a long time, from of old: 2Pe 2:3 3:5.†
(AS)

G1598.def:
ἐκ-πειράζω
[in LXX: Dt 6:16 8:2, 16 Sl 78:18 (נָסָה pi.) * ;]
= cl. ἐκπειράομαι,
to put to the proof or test, make trial of, tempt: with accusative, of God, Mt 4:7 (LXX), Lc 4:12 (ib.), 1Co 10:9; of Christ, Lc 10:25 (Cremer, 497).†
(AS)

G1599.def:
ἐκ-πέμπω
[in LXX for שָׁלַח ;]
to send forth: At 13:4 17:10.†
(AS)
